0.2.0.en: First release in the Homey App Store. Sends your devices, zones, energy and climate readings to a TRMNL e-ink display — on a timer and immediately whenever something in the home changes.

0.2.2.en: Corrected the app icon and store images to the TRMNL brand.

0.3.0.en: Pushing when a device changes is now a setting, and off by default. A busy home can use up the hourly push allowance in minutes, so it is now opt-in and spaced at least a minute apart.

0.3.1.en: Updated the App Store images to a real Homey screen.
